title: 听力挑战 · 观点辩论

rounds.speaker: 辩手
rounds.line: In my opinion, remote work improves productivity, provided that employees maintain clear daily schedules and goals.
rounds.lineCn: 在我看来,只要员工保持清晰的日常安排和目标,远程工作就能提高生产力。

grammar.name: 观点陈述 + 条件限定
grammar.note: In my opinion 引出观点;provided that 引导条件从句,是观点论述中给出前提条件的标准结构。

options.text: Remote work boosts productivity if schedules are kept clear.
options.feedback: 在有清晰安排的前提下,远程工作提升效率。

options.text: Remote work always reduces productivity in every case.
options.feedback: 辩手认为在条件满足时它提升生产力。

options.text: Remote work has no measurable effect on productivity.
options.feedback: 辩手明确认为它能提高生产力。

rounds.speaker: 辩手
rounds.line: Opponents may argue that teamwork suffers in virtual settings, but modern tools largely bridge that gap.
rounds.lineCn: 对方辩友可能会说团队合作在虚拟环境中受影响,但现代工具在很大程度上弥补了这一差距。

grammar.name: 反驳对方论点句式
grammar.note: Opponents may argue that... but... 是先立靶再反驳的辩论句式;bridge the gap 表示弥补差距。

options.text: Modern tools mostly close the teamwork gap online.
options.feedback: 现代工具能弥补远程协作的差距。

options.text: Modern tools make online teamwork even worse.
options.feedback: 工具起的是弥补而非加剧的作用。

options.text: The opponents completely agree with the speaker.
options.feedback: 对方观点被引用后即被反驳。

rounds.speaker: 辩手
rounds.line: From my perspective, the benefits of flexible hours outweigh the drawbacks when measured against long-term outcomes.
rounds.lineCn: 从我的角度看,就长期结果而言,弹性工作时间的利大于弊。

grammar.name: 利弊权衡句式
grammar.note: From my perspective 引出立场;outweigh 表利大于弊,when measured 是被动分词短语作状语。

options.text: Flexible hours bring more advantages than disadvantages in the long run.
options.feedback: 从长期看,弹性工时的好处超过坏处。

options.text: The drawbacks clearly outweigh the benefits of flexible hours.
options.feedback: 辩手认为利大于弊,而非弊大于利。

options.text: Flexible hours have no measurable long-term outcomes.
options.feedback: 辩手正是从长期结果来衡量利弊的。

rounds.speaker: 反方辩手
rounds.line: It cannot be denied that face-to-face communication remains valuable, yet it is not always necessary for every task.
rounds.lineCn: 不可否认面对面的交流仍然宝贵,但它并非每项任务都必需。

grammar.name: 让步转折框架
grammar.note: It cannot be denied that... 承认对方合理之处;yet 转折强调并非总是必需,是辩论的平衡手法。

options.text: Face-to-face contact is valuable but not essential for every task.
options.feedback: 面对面交流宝贵,但并非所有任务必需。

options.text: Face-to-face contact is essential for every single task.
options.feedback: 辩手认为它并非所有任务都必需。

options.text: Face-to-face contact is completely worthless today.

rounds.speaker: 辩手
rounds.line: To sum up, a balanced approach that combines remote flexibility with regular in-person meetings seems most reasonable.
rounds.lineCn: 总之,把远程灵活性与定期线下会议结合起来的平衡做法似乎最合理。

grammar.name: 辩论总结句式
grammar.note: To sum up 总起;that combines... with... 定语从句修饰 approach;seems most reasonable 给出最终立场。

options.text: A mix of remote work and in-person meetings is the most sensible option.
options.feedback: 远程与线下结合的做法最合理。

options.text: Only remote work is a sensible option.
options.feedback: 辩手主张的是结合两者,而非只选其一。

options.text: Only in-person meetings should be considered.
options.feedback: 平衡方案包含远程与线下,并非单方面。
